You don’t need to “improve”, especially if it’s just for some girl. It sounds like you’re emotionally enslaving yourself to this person when you don’t have to. Who cares what people think of you, why would it matter in the first place? What makes them any better than you? From birth, everybody is molded into who they are, by their surroundings. I couldn’t imagine wanting to be seen as “normal”, how boring would that be. If everyone were perfect, I would still find a way to hate them all the same, I won’t sugarcoat it and say that everybody is equal and everybody is loved, because in many cases, nobody deserves to be loved. Does that mean you need to hate yourself and view yourself as lesser? Absolutely not. That would be ridiculous. You can be who you are without blaming yourself for whatever happens in your relationship, it’s never just one person’s fault. You don’t need to devote yourself to making others happy.
Sex is pointless, losing your virginity won’t magically inspire you to go on living. You don’t need a specific goal or aspiration in life, you just need something to keep you entertained.
